name: Kurusu Akari
source:
One of the 3 girls in Koudai's group. A girl with classes. She is smart and her grades are among the highest in the class.

She doesn't self promote herself as much as Jasmin but she is a leader in her own right. She and Jasmin often clash with each other.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/LRG/lrg_info.html]Official site[/url]]
